entries.name: I_VBAT_bound
entries.condition: Worst-case retention-domain (VBAT) load bound = 10 x 1.2 uA typical MCU VBAT/backup-domain current, at VBAT minimum operating voltage
entries.citation: HwRS.md HW-FR-009 (v0.2.0): 'I = 12 uA (10x margin on 1.2 uA)' derived from the STM32G4 RTC VBAT current table (typ. 1.2 uA)

entries.name: V_VBAT_min
entries.condition: Retention floor for the VBAT domain at worst case (10% above the 1.55 V datasheet minimum VBAT operating voltage)
entries.citation: HwRS.md HW-FR-009 (v0.2.0): dv = 3.3 V - 1.65 V = 1.65 V at the VBAT minimum operating voltage (1.65 V typical); STM32G474 datasheet VBAT range 1.55 to 3.6 V

entries.name: V_BOR3
entries.condition: BOR level 3 threshold (falling) configured in option bytes; brownout floor of HW-SF-002 sub-event (ii)
entries.citation: HwRS.md HW-SF-002 (v0.2.0): 'main-rail brownout to BOR level 3 (2.8 V)'; STM32G4 BOR level table (oracle OR-008)

entries.name: V_main_nominal
entries.condition: Nominal 3V3 main rail / VBAT charge level at nominal 12 V vehicle supply (VBAT charged through the charge path while the rail is present)
entries.citation: HwRS.md HW-FR-009 (v0.2.0) derivation uses 3.3 V nominal; HW-PLAN C3 board rails
